_comment: Pexels source attribution for the verified dish photos used by Hotel Mumtaz, Coastal Crown, Kaka's Hotel Malabar and Moms Magic Kitchen. Every photo was visually checked against its dish before being committed. Photo URL pattern: https://www.pexels.com/photo/<pexelsId>/
_license: Pexels License and Unsplash License - both free to use commercially, no attribution required. Recorded here for traceability.
